questions.question: Pranita, Subhash, Kamini, Ved, Yamini and Satya are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Ved is second to the left of Yamini. Pranita is to the immediate right of Kamini. Only Yamini is between Kamini and Satya. Subhash is to the immediate left of Ved. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Ved?
questions.solution:
**Pranita, Subhash, Kamini, Ved, Yamini and Satya** are sitting in a straight line facing the north. 

1. Ved is second to the left of Yamini. 

2. Only Yamini is between Kamini and Satya. 

3. Subhash is to the immediate left of Ved.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0274cdb6c7246eb572031bae5fb78ace0d518893aa2bfd495f7fd47a1a327eb0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd1e3aab219ec372f2e3b6988cfcb340a27a3180dde6455e8a346bdcf3e2d05.png] 

4. Pranita is to the immediate right of Kamini. 

 
• The above condition is possible only in Case I, as there is no right position vacant for Pranita to occupy in Case II.
 
• Also, it is clear from statement 4 that Kamini is sitting to the immediate right of Yamini, which leaves Kamini's immediate right position vacant for Pranita to occupy.
 
• Therefore, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4c9f9a9c09e9c048ca98598f38d997f24fbaf240e9810d6af4b8941976a6986.png] 

Clearly, Satya is sitting to the immediate right of Ved.

Hence, '**Satya**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pointing towards Savitri, Kartik said, "She is the sister of my brother's mother's son." How is Savitri related to Kartik?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0bf23581ccab3a221a8d40bea79f14ac82f6ca711e364800f6b1af5c3da61c8.png] 

 
• My brother's mother's son → Kartik's Mother 's son is brother of Kartik.
 
• Savitri is the sister of my brother's mother's son → Savitri is the sister of brother of Kartik, which implies Savitri is the sister of Kartik.

Clearly, Savitri is sister of Kartik.

Hence, '**Sister**' is the correct answer.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All baskets are fruits.

Some fruits are utensils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some utensils are baskets.

II. Some utensils are fruits.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8afdd4726b92a5fac90a8943c2b9509fb88caaf152de9f37340479a6c19b1836.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some utensils are baskets. → Does not Follow (As, there is no definite relation between utensils and baskets. Hence, false)

II. Some utensils are fruits. → **Follow** (Some fruits are utensils)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements :

All snakes are crocodiles.

All crocodiles are turtles

All birds are crocodiles.

Conclusions : 

I. All snake are turtles.

II. All birds are turtles.

III. Some snakes are birds.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f292507f94ae77ba1828888b1e63a5f7913c936cf54135d85c5a1fb7aaa997c8.png] 

**Conclusions: **

I. All snake are turtles. →** Follow **(As, All snakes are crocodiles and All crocodiles are turtles)

II. All birds are turtles. →** Follow** (As, All birds are crocodiles and All crocodiles are turtles)

III. Some snakes are birds. → Does not Follow (As, there is no definite relation between snakes and birds. Hence, false)

Hence, **Only conclusion I and II follow**.
